budget: Exactly 16 staff-hour equivalents; shared immutable commitments. If aval purchased, pair with a nurse shift in first downstream ward. Alternative: 8h two-agent cleaning/transport reinforcement.
objective: External admission patient-minutes, used as boarding proxy. Internal transfer patient-minutes and uncovered staff minutes are co-primary guards. Saturation event: >=4 external requests concurrently waiting for >=4 consecutive 15min ticks.
references: public simulation rolling over same plan catalogue
direct trajectory regression rolling over same plans
target: At least 10 percent less external waiting relative to strongest aggregate TEST reference with positive lower bound on paired improvement, upper CI on care and transfer increases <=0 and equal actual resource use. 2000 bootstrap samples over hospitals. No TEST tuning.
learning: Multi-output ExtraTrees 80 trees min_samples_leaf=2 seed=20261120; regress paired sequence effects at 08h and paired continuation effects at noon, baseline trajectory learned separately. Select guard penalty from 0,1,4 on DEV. 90% absolute residual quantiles calibrated on DEV are descriptive.
